_readme: The active design system. scripts/render.py (via portfolio.py build) turns this into assets/css/tokens.css. A MINOR replaces this file and restyles assets/css/main.css; a MAJOR also rewrites scripts/render.py and assets/js/main.js. The first theme listed is the default. validate enforces WCAG contrast on every theme. fonts.display and fonts.mono are optional extra stacks (emitted as --font-display and --font-mono).
name: Monograph
concept: The coordination room is torn down and the portfolio is re-set as a printed monograph: a bound review of built work, typeset like an architectural journal. A masthead carries the publication name, the issue line (volume and number from the version) and a dateline; a Contents index with folio numbers is the navigation, echoed by a slim running-head bar that tracks the section you are reading. The body is an editorial measure: a leader essay opens with a drop cap, Selected Works runs as numbered features with plate figures and figure captions, the build-up films are motion plates, and the reinforcement drawings are a technical appendix. Pull quotes drawn from the work sit in the margin; hairline rules, folios and a colophon frame every page. Type is Bodoni Moda, a high-contrast Didone, for display, Newsreader for the reading measure and its italic pull quotes, and Courier Prime, a typewriter face, for folios, plate numbers and metadata. Signature motion: ink set. As a page enters the measure the display heading prints in left to right through a clipped ink gradient on a view() timeline, figure plates develop up from a halftone dot screen as a register rule is struck beneath them, and the drop cap inks in. Everything is static under reduced motion and without JavaScript.

fonts.body: "Newsreader", "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
